newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Alumindo edges up on debut.
newsitem.headline: Alumindo edges up on debut.

text.p: PT Alumindo Light Metal Industry edged up on its debut on the Jakarta stock exchange on Thursday amid weak sentiment, brokers said.

"Investors were generally cautious on Alumindo as they think it may perform as poorly as Sierad Produce, but there seems to be some support from the company which kept it slightly above its initial offer price," one broker said.
Agribusiness firm Sierad Produce briefly rose to 975 rupiah on its debut last Friday, but fizzled out soon after to close at 825 rupiah against the initial offer price of 900 rupiah.
Alumindo rose to a high of 1,425 rupiah against an offer price of 1,300 rupiah before easing to 1,375 rupiah, with volume close to 4.5 million shares after some 30 minutes of trading.
Alumindo, a member of the Maspion Group, is one of Indonesia's largest light metal manufacturers.
